description: Fetch a URL and run a full on-page SEO audit: title/meta description length, canonical tag, Open Graph + Twitter Card tags, html lang attribute, viewport meta, heading structure, image alt-text coverage, internal/external link counts and generic-anchor-text detection, robots meta (noindex/nofollow), structured data (JSON-LD) presence, robots.txt/sitemap.xml presence, and site chrome (favicon, apple-touch-icon, web app manifest, theme-color). Whole-page audit — for raw extracted data only use structured_data_extract, for the platform/framework use tech_stack_fingerprint.
name: seo_audit
